g.text: A team-chat coordinator with evidence-gated task completion
Python services • existing data store and worker • additive integration
does not decide whether proof is valid
No comments, approvals, merges or writes
@Saarathi task request → extract / validate → save task + dependencies → forecast and reminders
@Saarathi done + PR URL → check repo / author / scope / CI → Complete + unblock, or explain why it stays open
Safety rule: missing proof, scope mismatch, failed or pending checks, and GitHub errors never mark a task Complete.
A proof snapshot is checked against one PR head SHA before a single atomic task transition.
room_id • event_id • user_id • task_id • PR URL
resolve Switch ID to trusted member
head SHA + checks for that SHA
7 One DB transaction: CAS task.version / expected status
Success: append VERIFIED + COMPLETE event; insert outbox; commit
Conflict: rollback all writes; reload / revalidate
Duplicate Switch delivery: inbox key returns prior result; no second transition.
GitHub timeout / rate limit: PENDING_RETRY; task remains open.
PR head changes or a required check reruns mid-validation: discard snapshot and revalidate.
Author / repo / scope / failed check: REJECTED with reason; corrected proof starts new validation.
Concurrent owner / scope / blocker change: CAS fails; reload and revalidate.
Reply fails after DB commit: outbox retries without repeating the task transition.
Accepted race: a push after final read may follow commit; verified evidence remains tied to its SHA.
CAS on task.version and expected status; stale owner / scope / blocker aborts.
Reload and revalidate; every accepted transition appends one audit event.
Reversal uses a compensating event; history stays immutable.
REJECTED → AWAITING_PROOF with corrected / new evidence
Only VERIFIED authorizes COMPLETE; retry states stay open.
Evidence: canonical GitHub PR URL in an allowlisted repository.
Identity: Switch user ID maps to trusted member; text / LLM cannot assign owner.
Only owner / lead may record delegates; PR author must match owner or a listed delegate.
Scope is repo-relative POSIX globs and case-sensitive.
* and ? match within one path segment; ** can cross directories.
Require a nonempty diff; every changed path must match an allowed glob.
Rename: both old and new paths must match. Delete: deleted path must match.
Required check names are configured exactly per repository (optionally with app ID).
Each required check must appear on the same SHA and finish successfully.
Missing checks or a pending rerun → PENDING_RETRY; never auto-pass.
Final GitHub response must match SHA + checks.
Its timestamp to transaction start must be ≤5 seconds.
A later push is outside the accepted snapshot race; audit remains tied to SHA.
No LLM participates in proof validity.
Task store is authoritative; append-only events record actor, event ID, old / new state, PR URL, SHA, scope, checks, and reason.
Inbox uniqueness: (room_id, event_id); persist the Switch cursor.
One transaction: CAS task.version / expected status. Conflict → rollback all, reload and revalidate.
On success, append VERIFIED snapshot + COMPLETE event; insert outbox row; commit.
Outbox retries replies / reminders; failed delivery never repeats the task transition.
Demo: modular monolith + SQLite WAL; repository interface stays portable to Postgres. Add no queue until required.
